title: Mobile Mechanic Equipment Inspection Report Form
subtitle: Control mobile diagnosis, vehicle stabilization, repair, testing, and return or tow decision through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete mobile mechanic service equipment inspection report for vehicles, systems, components, fluids, tools, supports, and work-zone controls. It connects approved repair scope, service information, and site plan to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified mobile mechanic must inspect vehicles, systems, components, fluids, tools, supports, and work-zone controls against stated criteria and issue a traceable condition, restriction, corrective-action, or release decision.

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic inspection scope, criteria, and readiness
sections.guidance: Do not infer whole-asset or whole-site condition from a limited, inaccessible, or unqualified inspection.

blocks.label: Inspection access and control readiness
items: Vehicle authority, dispatch location, VIN, unit, and requested scope confirmed
Traffic, visibility, weather, terrain, lighting, and escape path assessed
Vehicle parked, braked, chocked, stabilized, and protected from impact
Jack, stands, lift points, cribbing, and ground capacity verified before elevation
Ignition, keys, battery, high voltage, stored pressure, heat, and moving parts controlled
Fuel, oil, coolant, refrigerant, battery, and spill or fire controls available
Service information, torque values, parts, tools, and recall status checked
Customer and bystanders kept outside the controlled work zone
Removed parts, fluids, batteries, tires, and contaminated material controlled
Functional test, leak check, roadworthiness decision, and tow route defined

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic equipment inspection report closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This mobile mechanic service equipment inspection report is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when traffic, vehicle support, lifting, stored energy, high voltage, fuel, fire, weather, spill, repair information, or roadworthiness condition is uncertain. A automotive or fleet safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
